disclaimer: All names and marks are fictional demonstration assets. They do not represent customers, partners, integrations or endorsements.

foundry-field.prompt:
Create one original standalone brand SYMBOL for a FICTIONAL residential rental
operator. This is an internal design mock, not a real company identity. Use a
clean premium flat geometric style that remains recognizable at 48 px. Use
exactly two solid colours, no gradients, no faux 3D, no bevel, no glow, no
shadow and no hairline detail. The mark should feel credible for professional
rental living: precise, warm, architectural and contemporary, not generic
fintech and not property clip art.

Return a square PNG with a genuinely transparent background. Render exactly one
compact symbol centered at 58-68% of canvas width/height with at least 15% clear
space on every edge. Use only the supplied primary and accent colours. Keep
forms bold, simple and optically balanced; no scene, mockup, tile, border,
enclosing app icon, arbitrary outline style or isometric perspective.

ABSOLUTELY NO WORDS, LETTERS, INITIALS, NUMBERS, TYPOGRAPHY, MONOGRAMS,
WATERMARKS, EXISTING LOGOS, TRADEMARKS, FLAGS, PEOPLE, KEYS OR ROOFTOP CLIP ART.
Do not imitate any named real operator or hospitality brand.

Operator segment: BTR in US.
Brand character: industrial premium.
Symbol brief: two heavy rectangular beams and one terracotta threshold defining an asymmetrical open courtyard, no letterform.
Palette: primary #332A28, accent #C56842.
The background must remain transparent; do not render the tile color #F2ECE6.
